1. Business Silver Rewards Card: Double Cash Back Promo
   ID: doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_012
   Score: 0.6053
   Content: ## Limited-time offer: double your cash back
New Business Silver Rewards Card customers can earn 2x cash back on all purchases for the first 6 months after opening their account.

## How it works
- Travel and software purchases that normally earn 10.0% are multiplied by 2 during the promotional period
- Other purchases that normally earn 1.0% are multiplied by 2 during the promotional period
- The increased rewards rate is automatically applied to qualifying transactions; no separate enrollment is required

## Promo period
- Start date: 2024-11-14
- End date: 2025-11-14

## Important details
- The 6-month window begins on your account opening date, not the promotional start date
- You must open your account during the promotional period to qualify
- Merchant category exclusions continue to apply (see Exceptions and Exclusions)
- Cash back is credited to your account at the end of each billing cycle consistent with program rules

2. EcoCard: New Customer Promo - Earn Bonus Sustainability Points
   ID: doc_credit_cards_ecocard_009
   Score: 0.5901
   Content: ## Offer Window
- This promotion runs from 2025-08-01 through 2025-12-15.

## How to Qualify
- Spend at least $5,000 in eligible purchases within your first 1 month of account opening.
- You must be a new customer and the account must be open and in good standing when the bonus is awarded.

## Bonus Amount
- Earn $2,000 sustainability points once you meet the spending threshold within the qualifying period.

## Posting Timeline
- Bonus points typically post after the qualifying period closes and your transactions have cleared.

## Exclusions and Tips
- Returns, chargebacks, and disputed transactions reduce your qualifying spend.
- Balance transfers, cash equivalents, and fees do not count toward the threshold.
- Track your progress in the Rewards section to ensure you meet the $5,000 requirement on time.

3. Silver Zoom Card: How to Claim Your Triple Cash Back Promo
   ID: doc_business_credit_cards_silver_zoom_card_013
   Score: 0.5561
   Content: ## Before you start
- Confirm that you are within the eligible claim dates of 2024-01-01 through 2025-12-31
- Ensure your account is open and in good standing

## Claim and activation
- Open your account portal and navigate to promotional offers
- Select the triple cash back offer and confirm your acceptance within the claim window
- Watch for an on‑screen or email confirmation that the offer is active

## After you claim
- Your promotional earning period runs for 9 months from account opening
- During the promo period, your earnings reflect a multiplier of 3
- Monitor your statements to verify promotional earnings are posting correctly

## If you miss the window
- Claims submitted after 2025-12-31 are not eligible for activation
- You can continue earning at your standard rates if the promo is not activated in time

4. Business Bronze Rewards Card: New Customer Promo Offer Details
   ID: doc_business_credit_cards_business_bronze_rewards_card_010
   Score: 0.5431
   Content: ## Promotion Window
- This offer is available from 2025-10-01 through 2026-03-31.

## How to Qualify
- Make net new purchases totaling $10,000 within the first 2 months of account opening.
- After qualification, a $500 statement credit will be applied to your account.

## What Counts Toward the Threshold
- Only net purchases count; returns or credits reduce your qualifying total.
- Transactions must post to your account within 2 months to be included.

## Tracking and Fulfillment
- Track your progress toward the $10,000 requirement in your account dashboard.
- The $500 will appear on a future statement after qualification is confirmed.

## Tips for Success
- Plan larger purchases early in the period so they post within 2 months.
- Keep documentation of purchases in case a transaction posts later than expected.

5. Bronze Rewards Card: New Customer Promo - 0% APR for the First Year
   ID: doc_credit_cards_bronze_rewards_card_008
   Score: 0.5416
   Content: ## What the Promo Offers
- New customers receive a 0% APR on carried balances for the first 12 months from account opening.

## When It’s Available
- Promotional window: 2025-09-01 through 2026-02-28.

## How to Qualify
- Open a new account during the promotional window.
- After the promotional period ends, your APR reverts to the standard rate of 20.49% on carried balances.

## How It Works During Your First Year
- Purchases you choose to carry will accrue interest at 0% during the promo period.
- Your statements will reflect the promotional rate for eligible balances within the first 12 months.

## After the Promo Period
- Any remaining or new carried balances will accrue interest at your standard APR of 20.49%.

## Managing the Transition
- Consider paying down larger balances before your 12‑month promo ends to minimize interest once the rate returns to 20.49%.
- Review your statement a cycle before the promo ends to plan payments accordingly.

6. EcoCard: New Customer Promo - 0% APR for the First Year
   ID: doc_credit_cards_ecocard_010
   Score: 0.5306
   Content: ## Promo Period
- Accounts opened during 2024-10-01 through 2025-03-31 are eligible.

## Promotional APR
- Enjoy a promotional APR of 0% on carried balances for the first 12 billing cycles from account opening.

## After the Promo Ends
- At the end of the 12-month promotional period, any remaining balance and new carried balances accrue interest at your standard rate of 19.99%.

## How to Make the Most of the Offer
- Set reminders for when your 12th billing cycle approaches so you can plan payoff strategies before the rate reverts to 19.99%.
- Consider larger early payments to reduce your balance during the 0% period.

## Important Notes
- You must keep your account open and in good standing to maintain eligibility for the promotional rate.
- The promotional rate applies from the date of account opening and lasts for 12 billing cycles.

7. Silver Rewards Card: New Customer Promo - $500 Statement Credit Signup Bonus
   ID: doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_010
   Score: 0.5287
   Content: ## Bonus Amount and Requirement
- Earn a statement credit of $500 when you spend $2,000 in the first 1 month(s) after account opening

## Offer Window
- Accounts must be opened within: 2025-01-01 to 2025-06-30

## How to Qualify
1. Open a new account during the offer window
2. Make qualifying purchases that post to your account totaling $2,000 within 1 month(s) from account opening
3. Keep your account open and in good standing through the bonus fulfillment date

## What Counts Toward the Threshold
- Net purchases (purchases minus returns/credits) that post within the qualifying period

## When You’ll Receive the Credit
- The $500 typically posts within two billing cycles after you meet the spending requirement

## Tips
- Set recurring bills and subscriptions on your card immediately after approval to reach $2,000 within 1 month(s)
- Track posted transactions (not just authorizations) to confirm progress toward the threshold

8. Platinum Rewards Card: Earning 10% Cash Back
   ID: doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_002
   Score: 0.5263
   Content: ## How You Earn
- You earn 10.0% cash back on all eligible purchases.
- Returns or credits reduce previously earned rewards on a per-transaction basis.

## Eligible and Ineligible Transactions
- Eligible: point-of-sale and online purchases posted to your account.
- Not eligible: cash advances, balance transfers, fees, interest, and other cash-equivalent transactions.

## Posting Timeline
- Rewards accrue when transactions post to your account and typically become available after the purchase posts and clears any return window.

## Redeeming Your Rewards
- You can redeem once your available rewards balance reaches at least $15.
- Common redemption options include statement credits or other available channels in your account dashboard.

## Tips to Maximize Earnings
- Use the card for everyday spend to capture 10.0% on all categories.
- Set the card as your default payment at frequently used merchants.
- Consider your net rewards after the $200.00 annual fee when planning large purchases.

9. Internal: Credit Card Rewards - Points vs Cash Back Representation
   ID: doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_006
   Score: 0.5257
   Content: ## Rewards representation
Due to a legacy backend migration that has not yet been completed, all credit card rewards in the transaction database are stored as 'points' regardless of whether the card is a cash back card or a points-based card. For cash back cards (Bronze Rewards Card, Silver Rewards Card, Gold Rewards Card, Platinum Rewards Card, Diamond Elite Card, Crypto-Cash Back, Business Bronze Rewards Card, Business Silver Rewards Card, Green Rewards Card, Silver Zoom Card, Business Gold Rewards Card, and Business Platinum Rewards Card), these 'points' should be interpreted as cash back with a conversion rate of 1 point = $0.01 when redeemed as a statement credit or as a credit to the user's Rho-Bank checking account. For example, 250 points equals $2.50 in cash back, which matches a 2.5% cash back rate on a $100 purchase. The only true points-based card is the EcoCard, which earns 'sustainability points' (5 points per dollar on green purchases, 1 point per dollar on other purchases) that also redeem at $0.01 per point when redeemed as a statement credit or checking account credit.

10. Platinum Rewards Card: Maximizing Your Premium Benefits and Rewards
   ID: doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_007
   Score: 0.5233
   Content: ## Everyday Earning
- Use the card for daily purchases to earn 10.0% on all categories without rotating caps.

## International Spending
- Take advantage of 0% foreign transaction fees when traveling or purchasing from foreign merchants.

## Annual Fee Rebate Strategy
- Earn a $150.00 rebate on your annual fee by meeting a monthly spend threshold of $7500.00.
- Automate large, predictable expenses on the card to help consistently meet the threshold.

## Smart Redemption
- Redeem rewards once your balance reaches at least $15 to keep value working for you.

## Purchase Protection Use
- For eligible items, keep receipts and documentation to leverage purchase protection for up to 135 days after purchase.
- The maximum coverage per claim is $17,500, subject to policy terms and exclusions.

## Putting It Together
- Channel recurring bills, travel, and major purchases through the card to earn at the flat rate, avoid foreign fees, and meet the monthly threshold for the annual fee rebate.
